doc: Named code versions for tools/eval/metrics.py --group-by version / family (docs/eval.md section 2). A run belongs to the last entry whose commit is an ancestor of (or equal to) the run's code commit (runs.jsonl `code`, `+dirty` stripped); runs older than the first entry are 'before <first name>'. Keep the entries in time order; give each the decision-log line (or tag) that says when it went live. Add V4 here (its first playing commit) before comparing V4 runs.
